siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near ES:SENZ
siblings.summary: ES:SENZ is inside Das Achental Resort, so the only true zero-walk option is to sleep on-site — alternatives in Mietenkam village put you 5–15 min on foot.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of ES:SENZ
siblings.summary: Six character properties within a 15-minute taxi of ES:SENZ in Grassau, ranked from medieval-castle pedigree to 1604 fisherman's stone house — plus the late-ferry trick that lets you sleep on Fraueninsel.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of ES:SENZ
siblings.summary: Decision-grade guide to Chiemsee islands, Chiemgau peaks, castles, towns, spas and rainy-day picks inside a 30 km radius of Das Achental.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of ES:SENZ
siblings.summary: The 30 km radius around ES:SENZ in Grassau covers Traunstein and Rosenheim — a small but active scene.

sources.title: Das Achental — ES:SENZ restaurant page
sources.claim: ES:SENZ is the in-house three-star Michelin restaurant inside Das Achental and has multiple closed weeks across 2026 including 01.06–07.06.

sources.title: Das Achental Resort (official)
sources.claim: Das Achental Resort has 12+ room categories, a 2,000 m² spa with infinity pool and multiple in-house restaurants, and sells an es:senz Dine & Sleep package from €515 pp/night.

sources.title: Taxi Chiemgau (24h Zentrale)
sources.claim: Taxi Chiemgau is the regional 24-hour taxi central serving Grassau and the Chiemsee area.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — ES:SENZ Grassau
sources.claim: Michelin lists ES:SENZ at Mietenkamer Straße 65, 83224 Grassau, three stars (2024).

sources.title: Das Achental — getting here
sources.claim: Das Achental sits on the outskirts of Grassau, reached via a 900 m turnoff from Bahnhofstrasse onto Mietenkamer Straße.

sources.title: HRS — Das Achental listing
sources.claim: Das Achental is a 4-star hotel at Mietenkamer Str. 65 with the Grassau town centre about 0.62 mi (1 km) away.

sources.title: Chiemsee-Alpenland — Gästehaus Hochgern
sources.claim: Gästehaus Hochgern, Steinwinkelstr. 30, 83224 Grassau-Mietenkam, is a few minutes' walk from the Grassau moor and Golf Resort Achental.

sources.title: Grassau.info — Hotel-Gasthof Sperrer
sources.claim: Hotel-Gasthof Sperrer is at Marktstraße 4, in Grassau's centre, 0.1 mi from the main square — i.e. ~1.5–2 km from Das Achental.

sources.title: Chiemsee-Alpenland — Ferienwohnungen Moritz
sources.claim: Ferienwohnungen Moritz at Heideweg 15, 83224 Grassau, offers vacation apartments next to the 18-hole golf course; non-smoking, no pets.

sources.title: Chiemsee-Alpenland — Ferienwohnung Kreuz
sources.claim: Ferienwohnung Kreuz is at Willy-Reichert-Straße 2, 83224 Grassau/Mietenkam, reached by turning left 50 m past the Mietenkam church; phone +49 8641 697960.

sources.title: Kleinrachlhof (official) — apartments
sources.claim: Kleinrachlhof, Niederfeldstraße 55, 83224 Grassau, has five vacation apartments (28–74 m²) plus pension rooms.

sources.title: ReadyToTrip — Das Achental aggregator
sources.claim: Aggregator nightly rates for Das Achental Resort start around €448 (130+ guest reviews).

sources.title: Les Grandes Tables du Monde — es:senz
sources.claim: ES:SENZ is a member of Les Grandes Tables du Monde — a tasting-menu, wine-paired three-star kitchen.

sources.title: Ferienwohnungen Moritz (official)
sources.claim: Ferienwohnungen Moritz has three modern vacation apartments at Heideweg 15, 83224 Grassau, in immediate vicinity of the Grassau 18-hole golf course; phone 08641/3921.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Das Achental
sources.claim: Das Achental has 179 rooms and is a 4-star resort with extensive Tripadvisor reviews.

sources.title: Das Achental — chef Edip Sigl
sources.claim: Edip Sigl is the named culinary director of es:senz at Das Achental.
